decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey rear conservatory extension, by way of its position, size, scale and design would not harm the appearance of the dwelling or the immediate locality and would not harm neighbours' living conditions and therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
description: Erection of single storey conservatory to rear of dwelling house.
